title: Stages of Clarity
subtitle: Discerning, Vigilant, Resolute, Enlightened
text: Clarity is the second measure, unlocked by Clarity Ascension at full Purity. Raise it through Clarity observances, accepted Altar offerings, and the path's rites. Each Clarity stage grants its Still Arts automatically; rites do not teach them. Discerning (25), Vigilant (50), Resolute (75), and Enlightened (100) strengthen the Silver Ward and unlock the stage's listed Arts.
